note: Dates change every year. 'checked' = this cycle verified on an official or reliable source on that date; otherwise 'timing' shows the usual pattern from past years.

items.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
items.covers: Full tuition, SEK 12,000 a month living allowance and a SEK 15,000 travel grant.
items.who: Citizens of eligible countries with work and leadership experience. Fields: governance, public health, entrepreneurship and innovation, STEM.

items.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
items.covers: No tuition, monthly stipend, housing contribution and medical insurance.
items.who: Citizens of partner countries (Bangladesh is a partner). Hundreds of English-taught programmes.
items.timing: Usually November to mid-January (last year: 15 January)

items.name: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları)
items.covers: Tuition, monthly stipend, dormitory, health insurance, return flight and a one-year Turkish language course.
items.who: Open to students from all countries.
items.timing: Usually 10 January to 20 February (last year's dates)

items.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) — Graduate
items.covers: Tuition, monthly allowance, return flight and a one-year Korean language course.
items.who: Apply through the Korean embassy in your country or directly to a participating university.
items.timing: Usually February to March

items.name: MEXT Research Student Scholarship
items.covers: Tuition, monthly stipend and return flight.
items.who: Apply through the Embassy of Japan (written test and interview) or through a Japanese university.
items.timing: Embassy route: usually April to May

items.name: Chevening Scholarships
items.covers: Tuition for a one-year master's, monthly living allowance, return flight and visa costs.
items.who: Citizens of Chevening countries with about 2 years (2,800 hours) of work experience.
items.timing: 2027-28 round closed 6 October 2026. The next round usually opens in August.

items.name: Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships
items.covers: Tuition, monthly stipend, return flight and allowances.
items.who: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries, usually nominated through a national body in your home country.
items.timing: Usually September to October (deadlines set by your national nominating body)

items.name: DAAD scholarships (incl. development-related postgraduate courses, EPOS)
items.covers: Monthly stipend, health insurance and travel allowance; tuition is free or low at most German public universities.
items.who: Depends on the programme. EPOS courses are for graduates from developing countries with work experience.
items.timing: Varies by programme; many EPOS courses close between August and October

items.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarships
items.covers: Tuition, monthly allowance, travel and insurance, while studying in two or more European countries.
items.who: Open to students from all countries. You apply to a specific joint master's programme.
items.timing: Usually October to February (each programme sets its own deadline)

items.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
items.covers: Tuition, accommodation, monthly stipend and medical insurance.
items.who: Apply through the Chinese embassy or directly to a participating Chinese university.
items.timing: Usually January to April

items.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
items.covers: Tuition, return flight, living allowance and health cover.
items.who: Citizens of participating countries in the Indo-Pacific, including South Asia.
items.timing: Usually February to April for South Asia

items.name: Research Training Program (RTP) scholarships
items.covers: Tuition offset and a living stipend, awarded by each Australian university.
items.who: Apply to an Australian university's research degree; most consider you for RTP automatically.
items.timing: Varies by university (often August to October for the next year)

items.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
items.covers: Tuition, living stipend, flights and health insurance (varies by country).
items.who: Run separately in each country by the US Embassy or Fulbright Commission.
items.timing: Varies by country — check the US Embassy in your country

local.label: US Embassy in Bangladesh — exchange programs

items.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
items.covers: Full funding for any Stanford graduate degree, plus leadership training.
items.who: Open to all nationalities; apply alongside your Stanford graduate application.
items.timing: Usually closes in early October

items.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
items.covers: Full cost of study at the University of Cambridge, living allowance and flights.
items.who: Open to all non-UK citizens applying to Cambridge.
items.timing: Usually October to early December/January, with your Cambridge application

items.name: Clarendon Scholarships (Oxford)
items.covers: Tuition and a generous living grant at the University of Oxford.
items.who: All graduate applicants to Oxford are considered automatically — no separate form.
items.timing: Apply to Oxford by the December/January course deadline

items.name: Holland Scholarship
items.covers: A one-off €5,000 grant in the first year (partial funding).
items.who: Non-EEA students starting a master's at a participating Dutch university.
items.timing: Usually 1 February or 1 May, depending on the university

items.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
items.covers: Monthly allowance, return flight, insurance and cultural activities (tuition not included).
items.who: The French university applies on your behalf — contact your chosen programme first.
items.timing: Usually November to January (university deadlines are earlier)

items.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
items.covers: Monthly stipend, tuition exemption, health insurance and housing allowance.
items.who: Researchers from eligible countries, with a Swiss professor who agrees to supervise you.
items.timing: Varies by country (often September to December)

items.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
items.covers: Monthly stipend and a conference/research travel allowance for up to 3–4 years.
items.who: Open to all nationalities applying to a PhD at a Hong Kong university.
items.timing: Usually September to 1 December

items.name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
items.covers: Full tuition, monthly stipend, one-time airfare and settling-in allowance.
items.who: Open to all nationalities for PhD research in science and engineering at NUS, NTU, SUTD or A*STAR.
items.timing: Two rounds a year: usually by 1 June and 1 December

items.name: KAUST Fellowship (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
items.covers: Full tuition, living stipend, housing, medical and dental coverage, and relocation support.
items.who: All admitted students receive the fellowship. Science and engineering only.
items.timing: Main admission rounds usually December to February

items.name: OIST Graduate School PhD (Okinawa, Japan)
items.covers: Full tuition, research assistantship stipend, housing support and travel.
items.who: Open to all nationalities. Five-year interdisciplinary PhD taught in English.
items.timing: Main round usually closes in December

items.name: Max Planck International Research Schools (IMPRS)
items.covers: Paid PhD position (contract or stipend) at a Max Planck Institute.
items.who: Open to all nationalities. Each research school recruits separately, usually once or twice a year.
items.timing: Varies by research school

items.name: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships
items.covers: Monthly stipend and allowances for study at a German university.
items.who: International students enrolled or applying at a German university, with social or political engagement.
items.timing: Usually 1 March and 1 September

items.name: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education)
items.covers: Tuition support and a monthly living allowance.
items.who: Apply through the Taiwan representative office for your country.
items.timing: Usually February to March
